labels.quoted_results: Results quoted from the tools' own reports (verbatim)
labels.quoted_note: Each finding below is the examining tool's own wording, copied from the verified source file named with its SHA-256; RV Report does not reword or translate it ([EN]/[ES]/[FR]: only available in that language). RV Report's own signals about the record are listed separately above.

EMPTY_FILE.title: Empty file
EMPTY_FILE.shows: The file contains no data (0 bytes).
EMPTY_FILE.does_not_prove: It does not show whether the file was emptied deliberately or created empty.

EXTENSION_MISMATCH.title: Extension does not match content
EXTENSION_MISMATCH.shows: The name ends in .%{extension} but the content starts with the signature of a %{detected} file.
EXTENSION_MISMATCH.does_not_prove: Renaming is common and often innocent; it does not by itself prove an attempt to hide content.

EXECUTABLE_CONTENT.title: Executable content under another name
EXECUTABLE_CONTENT.shows: The content is a %{detected} program although the name ends in .%{extension}.
EXECUTABLE_CONTENT.does_not_prove: It does not show that the program is malicious; analyse it in an isolated environment.

DUPLICATE.title: Duplicate content
DUPLICATE.does_not_prove: Identical hashes show identical content, not who copied the file or when.

UNREADABLE.title: File could not be read
UNREADABLE.does_not_prove: It does not show that the file is damaged; permissions or locks can cause this.

EVIDENCE_HASH_MISMATCH_WITH_CASE.title: Differs from the evidence registered in the case
EVIDENCE_HASH_MISMATCH_WITH_CASE.shows: The %{algorithm} of this file is %{actual}, but evidence %{evidence_id} was registered at intake with %{expected}: the file examined is not bit-identical to the registered item.
EVIDENCE_HASH_MISMATCH_WITH_CASE.does_not_prove: Who changed the file, when, or whether the change was deliberate; the analysis still ran so the examiner can decide.

EVIDENCE_NOT_IN_CASE_REGISTRY.title: Not registered in the case
EVIDENCE_NOT_IN_CASE_REGISTRY.shows: No item of case %{case_id} was registered with this path or this content, so its continuity from intake cannot be shown.
EVIDENCE_NOT_IN_CASE_REGISTRY.does_not_prove: That the file is altered or irrelevant; it may simply not have gone through intake.

REGISTRY_PATH_CONTENT_CHANGED.title: Registered path now holds different content
REGISTRY_PATH_CONTENT_CHANGED.shows: This path was registered earlier as %{previous_id} with other content; the current content gets a new evidence ID.
REGISTRY_PATH_CONTENT_CHANGED.does_not_prove: Which version is the original or why the content changed.

RUN_EXCLUDED.title: Tool run excluded: failed verification
RUN_EXCLUDED.shows: The %{tool} run %{run_id} failed verification (%{reason}); none of its results is quoted in this report.
RUN_EXCLUDED.does_not_prove: A failed check shows the run's record cannot be relied on as written, not that the evidence or the examiner did anything wrong; the run can be repeated on a verified copy.

REGISTRY_MISMATCH_REPORTED.title: A tool examined a copy that differs from the registry
REGISTRY_MISMATCH_REPORTED.shows: The %{tool} run %{run_id} recorded that the copy of %{evidence_id} it examined does not match the hash values registered at intake.
REGISTRY_MISMATCH_REPORTED.does_not_prove: It does not show which copy is the original or that anyone altered it; its results describe that copy only.

ITEM_NOT_EXAMINED.title: Registered item not examined by any analysis tool
ITEM_NOT_EXAMINED.shows: %{evidence_id} (%{file}) was registered at intake but no verified run of an analysis tool examined it.
ITEM_NOT_EXAMINED.does_not_prove: Nothing is known about its content beyond its hash values; it is not suspicious for that reason.

TIMELINE_PREDATES_RUNS.title: Timeline built before a quoted run finished
TIMELINE_PREDATES_RUNS.shows: The timeline run %{timeline_run} started before the %{tool} run %{run_id} finished, so it may not include that run's times.
TIMELINE_PREDATES_RUNS.does_not_prove: It does not show that the timeline is wrong; rebuild it with RV Timeline to include every run.

UNKNOWN_TOOL.title: Tool unknown to RV Report
UNKNOWN_TOOL.shows: RV Report has no description of %{tool}; its verified findings are quoted as written, without a summary of its method.
UNKNOWN_TOOL.does_not_prove: It says nothing about the reliability of that tool; read its own documentation.

TRANSLATION_UNAVAILABLE.title: Tool wording not available in this language
TRANSLATION_UNAVAILABLE.shows: The %{tool} run %{run_id} wrote its findings in %{available} only; the %{lang} report shows that wording, marked, without translating it.
TRANSLATION_UNAVAILABLE.does_not_prove: It does not change any result; re-run the tool with --lang %{lang} for its own wording.

TIMELINE_ABSENT.title: No timeline in the case
TIMELINE_ABSENT.shows: No verified RV Timeline run was found: the report has no timeline section content.
TIMELINE_ABSENT.does_not_prove: It does not mean the times are consistent or inconsistent; build a timeline with RV Timeline if time matters.

JURISDICTION_DIFFERS_FROM_CASE.title: Report structure differs from the case's jurisdiction
JURISDICTION_DIFFERS_FROM_CASE.shows: The report follows the %{requested} structure; the case folder is registered under %{case}.
JURISDICTION_DIFFERS_FROM_CASE.does_not_prove: It is a choice of the examiner, not a defect of the evidence.

limitations.SIGNATURE_TABLE_LIMITED: Type detection uses a limited table of common file signatures; unknown types are reported as unknown, not as suspicious.
limitations.TIMESTAMPS_FROM_FILESYSTEM: Modification times come from the file system of the examined copy and may differ from the original source.
limitations.CLEAN_RESULT_IS_NOT_AUTHENTICITY: A result without findings does not prove that a file is authentic or unaltered before acquisition.
limitations.TIMESTAMP_PROVES_EXISTENCE_ONLY: A trusted timestamp proves the audit log existed in this exact form at the stated time; it does not prove that the examined copy matches the original source.
limitations.REPORT_DERIVED_CONTENT: This report is derived content: it repeats what the tools recorded, so an error in a tool's analysis passes into it unchanged. Its weight rests on each quoted tool's validation and on the examiner's review.
limitations.REPORT_QUOTES_ONLY_VERIFIED_RUNS: Only runs whose audit chain, case-log anchor, timestamps and recorded outputs verify are quoted; an excluded run's results are absent even if they were correct.
limitations.REPORT_NO_CONCLUSION: RV Report writes no conclusion and no answer to the mandate's questions: those are the expert's opinion.
limitations.REPORT_LEGAL_STRUCTURE_UNVERIFIED: The section structure and the legal references follow the suite's draft admissibility notes; every reference is marked to be verified until counsel has reviewed it.
limitations.REPORT_NO_TRANSLATION: Quoted wording is never translated: a finding written by a tool in another language is shown in that language, marked.

intro.evidence: Items as registered at intake in the case registry (evidence/registry.json, verified). Custody rows come from the hash-chained case log (registration) and from every verified tool run that compared the item with the registry before examining it.
intro.method: The examination was performed with the Rakvor tools listed below. Before anything was quoted, RV Report:
intro.results: For each evidence item, every verified tool run that reported on it, with its findings quoted verbatim from that run's own technical report (file and SHA-256 given). A finding states what it shows and what it does not prove.
intro.timeline: Summary of the latest verified RV Timeline run of the case (its own statistics report). Its signals about each item are quoted under the results.
intro.limitations: Each tool's limitations as its runs printed them, then RV Report's own.
intro.not_examined: Registered items that no verified run of an analysis tool examined (the intake, the timeline and this report do not examine content).
intro.annexes: Every tool run found in the case folder and what RV Report did with it. Excluded runs failed verification and are never quoted.

method_steps.verify_case: verified the case log (hash chain), case.json and the evidence registry digest;
method_steps.verify_runs: verified every tool run: audit chain intact, run finished and anchored in the case log, timestamp tokens, and every output re-hashed against the digest its audit log recorded; a run that fails is excluded and never quoted;
method_steps.quote: quoted each finding and limitation verbatim from the tool's own report, without rewording or translating it;
method_steps.not_examined: listed the registered items that no analysis tool examined. RV Report never opened the evidence itself.

rv-hashinv.role: Evidence intake and inventory: registers each item in the case registry with one or two hash values and detects the file type.
rv-hashinv.checks: Hash values, file type against the extension, duplicates, empty or unreadable files.

rv-pdfauth.role: PDF authenticity signals: reads the document's structure and revision history.
rv-pdfauth.checks: Incremental updates and revisions, metadata dates, producer software, fonts, digital signatures and changes made after signing, visual differences between revisions.

rv-imgauth.role: Image authenticity signals for JPEG, PNG, WebP and HEIC files.
rv-imgauth.checks: File structure, EXIF/XMP metadata and editing software traces, quantization tables, double compression, and visual aids (error level, noise) for the examiner.

rv-mailauth.role: E-mail authenticity signals for .eml and .mbox messages.
rv-mailauth.checks: DKIM signatures against the keys supplied, Received headers and their order, dates, sender consistency and impersonation heuristics.

rv-rsmf.role: Converts chat exports (WhatsApp, …) into RSMF for review platforms, with a trace of every message.
rv-rsmf.checks: Parsing of the export and faithful conversion; it does not authenticate the content of the export.

rv-certcheck.role: Certificate and trusted-timestamp validation at a given date.
rv-certcheck.checks: Certificate chains, validity periods, revocation against the CRL/OCSP supplied, RFC 3161 tokens.

rv-timeline.role: Builds one cited timeline of the case from the other tools' verified outputs.
rv-timeline.checks: Orders every recorded time in UTC and compares sources (dates after intake, clock skew, dates in the future); it opens no evidence.

rv-avauth.checks: Container structure (MP4/MOV, OGG/Opus, WAV, MP3) and encoder traces.

rv-triage.role: Live Windows triage: collects volatile data and system artefacts into a hashed package registered at intake.
rv-triage.checks: What it collected and the hash of every collected file; it does not analyse the artefacts.
